requirements.description: Official SEC accounting-enforcement releases used to identify nonduplicate AAERs containing the source’s fraud screen.

required_coverage.detail: Release/publication dates (1996–2003) differ from alleged-fraud periods and annual predictor rows.

requirements.description: First alleged fraud year and allegation-period dates needed to assign fraud status and time predictors.

required_coverage.population: The paper’s 50 SEC-accused sample firms.
required_coverage.detail: Table 2 displayed alleged periods span 1992–2002; AAER release years are 1996–2003. Case predictors use F−1 except stated early 1992 substitution.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat data for leverage, ROA, sales growth, acquisition contribution and SIC effects.

required_coverage.population: Case, matched-control and retained unmatched firm-years.
required_coverage.detail: Case predictors are F−1 (1991–2001 for displayed F=1992–2002); sales growth needs t−1; M&A for matched controls can use F−2=1990, while fraud-case M&A needs F through 2002.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America merged annual fundamentals (current vintage)

routes.coverage_notes: Exact fields are present; no coordinator confirmation establishes source population or annual coverage.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coverage confirmation supports the full 1990–2002 population or paper-era vintage.

requirements.description: Compustat operating cash flow, capital expenditures and current assets used in FREECASH.

required_coverage.population: Matched and unmatched sample firms including accused cases.
required_coverage.detail: Earliest case row t=1991; FREECASH uses oancf_t, average capx from t−3 to t−1 and act_t−1. The denominator is checked separately and falls inside the t−3:t−1 CapEx interval; earliest input year 1988.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America annual fundamentals
routes.mapping_notes: Labels support current assets, capital expenditures and operating cash flow.
routes.coverage_notes: Exact fields are readable, but no coordinator coverage confirmation establishes required years/population.

requirements.description: Market equity, book-to-market and earnings-to-price inputs based on the paper’s historical Compustat items.

required_coverage.population: Matched and unmatched firms, including pre-fraud case rows.
required_coverage.detail: Fraud-case ratio year is F−1 (1991–2001); current candidate fields are price/shares, parent/common equity and earnings/EPS, but exact #199/#25/#216/#172 mapping and EPS/book-equity basis remain unresolved.

routes.source_name: WRDS Compustat North America annual fundamentals

required_coverage.population: 50 case firms and two nonfraud controls per case.
required_coverage.detail: Use SIC, year and total assets at the prior-fraud/matched reference year. Distance, ties and replacement are not specified.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Current horizons do not establish exact option-life inputs and no coverage confirmation exists.
